name: Jasper
overview: Jasper is depicted in Scripture as a precious stone of great significance, prominently featured in the high priest's breastplate, where it is set in gold as part of the fourth row of stones (Exodus 28:20; 39:13). Additionally, jasper symbolizes purity and divine beauty in the New Jerusalem, as the city's wall is described as being made of jasper, emphasizing its glory and holiness (Revelation 21:18). The foundation of the heavenly city also begins with jasper, highlighting its foundational role among the precious stones adorning the eternal city (Revelation 21:19).
